answer.ruling: Supply 20 warriors. Place one roost and six warriors in a corner that is not another player's starting corner; choose a corner diagonally opposite a starting corner if possible.
Choose a leader and keep the other leaders face up nearby. Tuck the two bird Loyal Viziers into the Decree columns listed on that leader.
Put the other six roosts on the roost track from right to left.
